I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the site is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 got written down on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

Neither the channel nor the public files say whether it was fixed, so my reply suggests she check with Hollis before marking it resolved. I also mentioned the other Marrow store from that day, Eastbank, so she doesn't mix them up: its problem was the door labels not matching on ticket PD-4821.

I only looked at #central-team, which Pree is in, and the public shared files.
